batch: Qt 'Batch...' opens a modal dialog; native has the Batch anisotropy tab beside the controls (Add files..., Run batch, Save table..., Clear batch, results table)
bgparallel: Qt 'BG Parallel:' read-only field: native results table row 'Background VV'
bgperpendicular: Qt 'BG Perpendicular:' read-only field: native results table row 'Background VH'
correctedg-factor: Qt 'Corrected G-Factor:' field: native results table row 'G corrected'
correctedstddev: Qt 'Corrected StdDev:' field: native results table row 'G corrected SD'
stddev: Qt 'StdDev:' field: native results table row 'G SD'
dt[ns/ch]: Qt spin box caption: native field 'dt (ns/bin)'
rho[ns]: Qt spin box caption: native field 'rho (ns)'
tau[ns]: Qt editable tau box (typing overrides): native 'Manual lifetime' toggle + 'tau (ns)' field, estimate in the Mixing estimate table
l1/l2: Qt editable l1/l2 box (typing overrides): native 'Manual l1 = l2' toggle + field, estimate in the Mixing estimate table
flipvvvh(dataswappedinvv/vh): Qt caption: native toggle 'Flip VV/VH' (tooltip carries the explanation)
loadfpvv/vhfile: Qt 'Load FP VV/VH File': native 'Slow protein...'
showcorrected: Qt 'Show corrected': native checkbox 'Corrected' in the decay window
showfastdye: Qt 'Show fast dye': native checkbox 'Fast reference'
showslowdye: Qt 'Show slow dye': native checkbox 'Slow reference'
Qt idle warning text: native shows 'Warning: load FP VV/VH data to estimate l1/l2.' (case/punctuation)
